name: İguana
scene: An iguana with a sweeping curled tail rests on a diagonal branch among tropical fronds.
notes: Target 84–124 panes. Generated with fox and poppies design references, then regenerated once after visual review to simplify claws and remove transparent exterior. Final visual review: recognisable iguana, oval rim and subject/background colour pairs retained. Remaining issues for tracing: subtle fill shading persists; short open toe strokes remain; some crowded or possible four-way contacts occur around dorsal crest, limbs and lower tail; some same-colour neighbouring pieces may merge. Pane count is a design target, not a verified geometry count. Design sheet only; not production geometry or final glass artwork.
